## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

representation.name: Codex Swarm Model Fit
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1) stop('Expected one input path')
input_path <- args[[1]]

library(splines)

dat <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
required <- c('DishNumber','StrainNumber','Ratio','Replicate','Area')
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(dat))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) stop(paste('Missing columns:', paste(missing_cols, collapse = ', ')))

dat$StrainNumber <- as.character(dat$StrainNumber)
dat$Ratio <- as.character(dat$Ratio)
dat$Area <- as.numeric(dat$Area)

curve <- dat[dat$StrainNumber %in% c('98', '287', '287_98'), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(curve) == 0) stop('No 287/98 curve rows found')

parse_mix_p <- function(ratio) {
  parts <- strsplit(ratio, ':', fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) != 2) stop(paste('Bad ratio:', ratio))
  a <- as.numeric(parts[[1]])
  b <- as.numeric(parts[[2]])
  if (!is.finite(a) || !is.finite(b) || a < 0 || b < 0 || (a + b) <= 0) stop(paste('Bad ratio:', ratio))
  a / (a + b)
}

curve$p <- NA_real_
curve$p[curve$StrainNumber == '98'] <- 0
curve$p[curve$StrainNumber == '287'] <- 1
is_mix <- curve$StrainNumber == '287_98'
curve$p[is_mix] <- vapply(curve$Ratio[is_mix], parse_mix_p, numeric(1))
curve <- curve[is.finite(curve$p) & is.finite(curve$Area), , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(curve) < 6) stop('Too few complete rows for candidate models')
if (min(curve$p) > 0 || max(curve$p) < 1) stop('Expected observed boundary rows p=0 and p=1')

models <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2), data = curve),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data = curve),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ ns(p, df = 4), data = curve)
)
aics <- vapply(models, AIC, numeric(1))
best_name <- names(aics)[which.min(aics)]
best_model <- models[[best_name]]

predfun <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(p = x)))
}

lower <- min(curve$p)
upper <- max(curve$p)
breaks <- seq(lower, upper, length.out = 1001)
candidates <- c(lower, upper, unique(curve$p))
for (i in seq_len(length(breaks) - 1)) {
  lo <- breaks[[i]]
  hi <- breaks[[i + 1]]
  opt <- try(optimize(function(z) -predfun(z), interval = c(lo, hi), tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(opt, 'try-error') && is.finite(opt$minimum)) candidates <- c(candidates, opt$minimum)
}
vals <- vapply(candidates, predfun, numeric(1))
idx <- which.max(vals)
opt_p <- candidates[[idx]]
max_pred <- vals[[idx]]

writeLines(formatC(max_pred, digits = 15, format = 'fg', flag = '#'), 'answer.txt')

aud <- data.frame(
  field = c('n_rows','best_model','optimal_p','max_predicted_area', paste0('AIC_', names(aics))),
  value = c(as.character(nrow(curve)), best_name, formatC(opt_p, digits = 15, format = 'fg', flag = '#'), formatC(max_pred, digits = 15, format = 'fg', flag = '#'), formatC(aics, digits = 15, format = 'fg', flag = '#')),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(aud, file = 'audit.tsv', sep = '\t', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.input.path)"
